title: Internal Technical Training
jobDescription:
The Internal Technical Trainer is responsible for designing, developing, and delivering technical training programs for engineering teams, customer support, and implementation engineers, QA, and other cross-functional departments. The role ensures employees remain up to date with Spintly's products, technologies, development standards, and industry best practices while accelerating onboarding and continuous learning. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design and deliver technical onboarding programs for new hires. Develop structured learning paths for Software, Firmware, Hardware, QA, Customer Success, and Technical Support teams. Create technical documentation, SOPs, training manuals, knowledge base articles, videos, and assessments. Conduct classroom, virtual, and hands-on training sessions. Train employees on: Spintly Access Control Solutions BLE (Bluetooth Low Energy) Io T Architecture Cloud Platform Mobile Applications (Android & i OS) REST APIs & SDK Integration RFID, NFC & Biometric Technologies Networking fundamentals Smart Building Solutions Work closely with Engineering and Product teams to stay updated on new releases and product enhancements. Build certification programs and evaluate employee technical competency. Track training effectiveness using assessments, quizzes, and performance metrics. Maintain the internal Learning Management System (LMS) and training calendar. Organize technical workshops, hackathons, and knowledge-sharing sessions. Support cross-functional teams with product demonstrations and technical enablement. Continuously improve training content based on feedback and business requirements. Required

QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Information Technology,Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 3-7 years of experience in technical training, engineering enablement, or technical education. Strong understanding of Io T ecosystems, cloud platforms, and mobile technologies. Experience with access control systems or physical security solutions is preferred. Familiarity with: Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) TCP/IP Networking REST APIs Android & i OS applications Embedded systems basics Cloud technologies SQL fundamentals Excellent presentation, communication, and facilitation skills. Experience using LMS platforms and e-learning authoring tools is an advantage. Preferred Skills: Ability to simplify complex technical concepts for diverse audiences. Strong documentation and technical writing skills. Experience creating video tutorials and interactive learning modules. Analytical mindset with excellent problem-solving skills. Comfortable working in a fast-paced product environment. Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.

title: Sales Coordinator
jobDescription:
Location: Fatorda Experience: 2-5 Years Salary: As per industry standards Job Overview: Spintly is looking for a highly organized and execution-focused Sales Coordinator to drive seamless coordination between the Sales, Operations, and Finance teams. This role is responsible for ensuring sales plans are executed efficiently, customer information is accurately maintained in the CRM, internal stakeholders remain aligned, and sales Operations run smoothly from lead generation through order closure and collections. The ideal candidate is proactive, detail-oriented, and thrives in a fast-paced environment where coordination, follow-up, and process discipline are critical. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Act as the central coordination point between the Sales, Operations, and Finance teams to ensure timely execution of customer orders and sales commitments. Own and maintain CRM hygiene by ensuring leads, opportunities, customer details, quotations, and sales activities are updated accurately and on time. Track the progress of sales opportunities and proactively follow up with internal teams and customers to remove execution bottlenecks. Coordinate client meetings, product demonstrations, presentations, and follow-up activities for the sales team. Prepare and manage sales documentation including quotations, proposals, contracts, purchase orders, and customer onboarding documents. Monitor sales receivables and coordinate with customers and the Finance team to ensure timely collections and payment follow-ups. Coordinate with the Operations team to track order execution, delivery timelines, installations, and customer onboarding. Generate periodic sales reports, pipeline reports, CRM dashboards, and business performance summaries for the leadership team. Ensure timely communication between customers and internal stakeholders throughout the sales lifecycle. Schedule meetings, maintain sales calendars, coordinate travel arrangements, and support other administrative requirements of the sales team. Maintain organized documentation and ensure compliance with internal sales processes and policies. Identify gaps in sales processes and recommend improvements to enhance operational efficiency. Required

QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Marketing, or a related discipline. 2-5 years of experience in Sales Coordination, Sales Operations, Sales Administration, or a similar role. Hands-on experience working with CRM platforms (such as Freshworks, Salesforce, Zoho CRM, Hub Spot, or similar). Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and Power Point. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across departments. Preferred Skills: Strong CRM management and data accuracy. Sales operations and pipeline management. Coordination across Sales, Operations, and Finance teams. Customer communication and follow-up management. Sales reporting, MIS, and dashboard preparation. High attention to detail and process orientation. Strong problem-solving, time management, and execution skills.

title: Sales Administrator
jobDescription:
Location: Bangalore Experience: 1-4 years About Us: Spintly is a cutting-edge technology company specializing in smart access control solutions. We are dedicated to revolutionizing the way organizations manage and secure their spaces through innovative and intelligent access control systems. Our team is passionate about creating seamless and secure access experiences for our clients. Job Overview: Spintly is seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented Sales Admin Coordinator to join our growing team in Bangalore. The successful candidate will play a crucial role in supporting the sales team and ensuring the smooth functioning of administrative processes. This position requires a candidate with strong organizational skills, excellent communication abilities, and the ability to multitask effectively.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Sales Support: Assist the sales team in managing and organizing client meetings, presentations, and demonstrations. Coordinate with internal departments to ensure timely delivery of product information and support materials to the sales team. Handle customer inquiries and provide necessary information to facilitate the sales process. Handle receivables
- monitor and track sales receivables via customer follow ups through calls and emails to customers. Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of sales activities, customer interactions, and leads. Administrative Support: Provide administrative support to ensure efficient office operations. Manage and organize documentation, including contracts, proposals, and other sales-related materials. Assist in scheduling and coordinating appointments, travel arrangements, and meetings. Handle general office tasks, including answering phone calls, managing emails, and maintaining office supplies. Data Management: Maintain and update customer databases, ensuring accuracy and completeness of information. Generate regular reports on sales activities, leads, and customer interactions. Support the sales team in data analysis to identify trends and opportunities. Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless communication and coordination between departments. Work closely with the sales team to understand customer requirements and provide necessary support.

QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field. Proven experience as a Sales Admin Coordinator or similar role (1 to 4 years). Strong organizational and multitasking skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Proficient in MS Office applications. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. title: Lead Qualification Specialist
jobDescription:
Spintly is looking for a Lead Qualification Specialist to be the first point of contact for all leads. This role is responsible for qualifying prospects, ensuring CRM accuracy, assigning leads to the right sales teams, and driving timely follow-ups to maximize conversions You will work closely with Marketing, Sales, and Business Development teams to ensure every lead is tracked, nurtured, and progressed through the sales funnel. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Qualify inbound leads received from website, campaigns, partners, events, referrals, and other marketing channels. Engage with prospects via phone, email, and Whats App to understand their requirements, project scope, timeline, and buying intent. Capture complete and accurate lead information in the CRM. Assign qualified leads to the appropriate sales representative based on region, industry, or account ownership. Track lead progress and ensure timely follow-ups by the sales team. Coordinate with sales teams to collect regular updates on opportunities and maintain CRM hygiene. Monitor lead ageing and ensure no qualified opportunity is missed. Generate daily and weekly reports on lead status, qualification, and conversion metrics. Work closely with the marketing team to provide feedback on lead quality and campaign performance. Maintain SLA adherence for lead response and qualification. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field. 1
- 2 years of experience in lead qualification, inside sales, sales operations, customer success, or business development. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Experience working with CRM platforms such as Freshsales, Hub Spot Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders and manage competing priorities. Good proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook. Preferred Skills: Experience working in a B2B Saa S, technology, or enterprise solutions company. Understanding of lead qualification frameworks is an advantage. Ability to analyze CRM data and identify gaps in the sales pipeline.

title: Technical Support Engineer
jobDescription:
We are seeking a highly motivated tech support engineer with his own experience and curiosity in electronics hardware and software to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for troubleshooting and resolving technical issues related to our company's hardware and software products. You will work closely with customers and internal teams to diagnose and resolve issues, utilizing your engineering skills. What you will be doing:
1. Providing support to the customers via phone, email, or chat, and assisting them in identifying and resolving technical issues related to Spintly hardware and software products.
2. Spintly has developed diagnostics tools to troubleshoot issues, you will be using those to analyse and solve issues.
3. Running Python scripts and other automation tools to streamline the debugging and testing process.
4. In the process of solving issues, you are expected to develop and maintain technical documentation for hardware and software products, including manuals, guides, and FAQs.
5. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product design engineers and software engineers, to identify and resolve complex technical issues.
6. Acquiring In-depth knowledge of products to understand how the issues need to be resolved.
7. Continuously update and maintain knowledge of the latest hardware and software technologies and trends. What qualifications & skills should you have?
1. Diploma / B.E or equivalent in / Electronics / Electronics & Communication/Computer science.
2. Strong interest and knowledge of electronics hardware, wiring and basic concepts.
3. Basic knowledge of scripting languages like Python or similar.
4. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate technical information to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
5. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think creatively and identify innovative solutions.

title: Quality Analyst Intern
jobDescription:
Location : Fatorda, Goa No. of hires : 1 Job description Overview Spintly is looking for a Quality Analyst (QA) Tester to assess software quality through manual and automated testing. You will be responsible for finding and reporting bugs and glitches. This role is suitable for candidates having 6 months-1 year experience and also freshers who have an interest in software testing and possess basic knowledge of APIs and Postman. Training will be provided to equip freshers with the necessary skills and knowledge to excel in manual testing methodologies, API testing, and the use of Postman for testing. This position offers a great opportunity to work on new and exciting projects. If you meet the requirements of this position for a Software Tester and possess the ability to work in a team environment as well as independently, please apply soon so that we can consider you for this great career opportunity. (This will be a 1 month paid internship, with the potential of transitioning to a full-time position based on performance)

RESPONSIBILITIES:
QA testers run various tests on software to ensure it meets all standards and guidelines and is ready to be marketed to consumers. They identify issues and run debugging programs as needed.QA testers also generate reports, work with software developers to correct issues, and upgrade databases as required. Your job may include: Reviewing software requirements and preparing test scenarios. Executing tests on software usability. Analyzing test results on database impacts, errors or bugs, and usability. Preparing reports on all aspects related to the software testing carried out and reporting to the design team. Requirements: Basic understanding of software development concepts and methodologies Strong interest in software testing and quality assurance Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field Familiarity with APIs and web technologies is a plus. Interview with us and if we find that you have the right attitude, we will train you. Send in your resume to [email protected]
